title: Stability and control of a vortex in a time-dependent strain field.
author: Rodrigo Badia Piccinini
abstract: This work addresses Batchelor's Vortex linear stability considering diffusion, stretching and determination of optimal perturbations. The mathematical problem and its numerical solution are outlined, presenting variable transforms, space discretization, finite-difference schemes and numerical methods. A periodic strain field and instantaneous flow parameters are defined and results are compared to available ones from modal analysis under quasistatic approximation. The convenient use of strain showed the possibility of active intervention in vortex dynamics, considerably changing time evolution of pertubations energy.
